<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Letters to joint policyholders show only one name or the wrong name because the Keelwater system fails to merge both names properly. This confuses recipients and erodes trust in communications.

## Who is affected
- Six accounts are affected, representing a total ARR of £5,580,000.0 [i:191159ac22dda8a3][i:3c348ad1d2e28b8c][i:45c010f06dcc57e3][i:666838190e575148][i:685a9720c023a304][i:784bbcdb220c64b5][i:7aef4ffdc807927e][i:8e8d4913f28f77f3][i:99cd195f0e22561c][i:99ed97781fb395fd][i:a493549d3d2021e9][i:a63d773b605f22e0][i:d407ed3449dc6468][i:e6dc24086d5b5b70][i:e81e5ea9868dbaf4][i:e9c39352aaac377c][i:f8fc05a94087512b].
- The issue is reported via three routes: support, sales, and account management [i:191159ac22dda8a3][i:45c010f06dcc57e3][i:7aef4ffdc807927e].
- Three accounts have renewals in the next 90 days: Stannary Commercial (2026-12-05), Tarnholt Drive Cover (2027-01-09), and Hollinbrook Home Insurance (2027-01-15) [i:685a9720c023a304][i:7aef4ffdc807927e][i:a63d773b605f22e0].

## Evidence
- There have been 17 mentions of this problem across the six accounts [i:191159ac22dda8a3][i:3c348ad1d2e28b8c][i:45c010f06dcc57e3][i:666838190e575148][i:685a9720c023a304][i:784bbcdb220c64b5][i:7aef4ffdc807927e][i:8e8d4913f28f77f3][i:99cd195f0e22561c][i:99ed97781fb395fd][i:a493549d3d2021e9][i:a63d773b605f22e0][i:d407ed3449dc6468][i:e6dc24086d5b5b70][i:e81e5ea9868dbaf4][i:e9c39352aaac377c][i:f8fc05a94087512b].
- The problem is causing direct customer complaints. For example, Hollinbrook Home Insurance reported three complaints in a month because joint policyholder names weren't merged correctly [i:666838190e575148]. Tarnholt Drive Cover states the issue is triggering formal complaints [i:e6dc24086d5b5b70].
- The issue forces manual workarounds. Linnet House Insurance reports manually editing letters before sending, which is time-consuming and prone to error [i:f8fc05a94087512b].
- The problem manifests as letters showing only one name or the wrong name. Callowfield Auto Assurance states letters come out with mismatched names [i:784bbcdb220c64b5]. Tarnholt Drive Cover confirms they're only pulling through one name, and it's causing complaints [i:e81e5ea9868dbaf4].
- The issue is reported by all three routes: 8 mentions via support, 6 via sales, and 3 via account management [i:191159ac22dda8a3][i:45c010f06dcc57e3][i:7aef4ffdc807927e].

## Why now
- The problem is actively generating complaints and friction with clients, as reported by multiple accounts in September and October 2026 [i:99cd195f0e22561c][i:e6dc24086d5b5b70].
- Three affected accounts have renewals approaching within the next 90 days, increasing the urgency to resolve a trust-eroding issue [i:685a9720c023a304][i:7aef4ffdc807927e][i:a63d773b605f22e0].
- Customers are explicitly asking for a resolution timeline. Stannary Commercial asked, Just need to know when we can expect the joint policyholder names to appear correctly in correspondence [i:99ed97781fb395fd].",
